scope: Map boss presentation utility only; no battle hookup, boss selection, stats or rewards.

source.note: User-provided, pre-existing untracked asset; unchanged. No variants exported.

api.preload: await prepareBossVariantImage(options) after loading begins and before future battle display

formula.random: Independent streamV1(special-map-v2, seed, JSON([boss-variant, version, bossId, purpose])) for hue/saturation/lightness
formula.rarityTuple: hue bias, saturation bias, lightness bias, random amplitude
formula.lightness: clamp(roll * .035 * strength * amplitude + bias - max(0, level-60)/40*.025, -.06, .06)
formula.note: Modest hue rotations do not universally move all source hues toward blue/yellow; saturation/lightness provide the main rarity tendencies.

protection: alpha unchanged; alpha=0 RGB also unchanged. correction multiplier clamp((L-.08)/.18,0,1)*clamp(S/.2,0,1). Dark outlines L<=.08 and true grayscale unchanged.
rendering: 600x600 native Canvas 2D; getImageData once, HSL transform, putImageData once; smoothing disabled. Destination renderer must also disable smoothing when scaling.
cache: 8-entry LRU (up to ~11 MiB pixel buffers excluding source/GPU storage). Includes version,bossId,imagePath,level,seed,rarity. Failure also cached; unloaded/wrong-sized image not cached. Clear removes references without invalidating canvases retained by callers.
fallback: Invalid/unsupported input, non-opted-in boss/path, unavailable canvas, CORS/readback failures return source image. Missing image returns undefined. Decode failure returns original image for existing image-loading error handling.
performanceNotes: 20 cold conversions after 3 warmups; 1000 cache calls. Browser timings include runtime scheduling/GC and timer precision. 390px is desktop Edge mobile emulation, not iPhone CPU. ~45ms first generation warrants preparation during a loading phase; prepare API supplied, battle hookup intentionally absent.
visualQa: PC and 390px: WHITE/SILVER/GOLD, Lv1/50/87, seed12345/42 inspected. Alpha mismatches zero; no horizontal overflow; same pixel hash in both contexts. Ordinary boss registry/runtime untouched; ordinary boss API passthrough verified. No Safari/iPhone hardware test.
tests: 1848 Node tests passed; six new unit tests. Browser harness passed.
suggestedCommit: Add deterministic HSL color variants and cached previews for map bosses
